test_title: PYST 39 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Minuscule'** is correctly spelled.
 
• **Meaning:** Extremely small or tiny.
 
• **Example:** The amount of error in the calculation was so minuscule that it was negligible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Miniscule** - Incorrect spelling. Commonly mistaken due to phonetic similarity.
 
• **Option 3: Miniscuele** - Incorrect spelling with an extra 'e'.
 
• **Option 4: Minouscule** - Incorrect spelling with an added 'o'.
